events.title: MTV turns 45
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, launched on August 1, 1981, revolutionising how music was consumed with its 24/7 music video programming. The first video ever played was 'Video Killed The Radio Star' by The Buggles.

angles.name: MTV impact
angles.copy: 45 years ago today, MTV launched and changed the music world forever. What was the first music video you remember watching that blew your mind?

events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which quickly became a landmark of the Britpop era and the fastest-selling debut album in British history at the time.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe anniversary
angles.copy: 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. That album defined a generation. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 years on
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, attracting nearly half a million concertgoers and becoming a pivotal moment in counterculture history.

angles.name: Woodstock anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and magic of Woodstock. A festival that truly changed everything. If you could have been there, who would you have wanted to see?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on August 16, 1977. He would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Elvis tribute
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the one and only King, Elvis Presley. His legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll generations.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13. He would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur, who left us far too soon. His words and music continue to resonate, 30 years on.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970. He would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work continues to inspire generations of musicians.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and its famous album cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most recognisable in music history. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still sounding as brilliant as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock and roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' on September 9, 1971, featuring the timeless title track.

angles.name: Imagine album anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon gave us the 'Imagine' album. A masterpiece of peace and hope that still resonates today.

events.title: The iPod: 25 years since its debut
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players.

angles.name: iPod anniversary
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple introduced the first iPod and put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. Who remembers their first iPod, and what was on it?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007 and his incredible legacy. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician and co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire peace and love around the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from the album?
